title: Run a useful daily stand-up
summary: A short daily meeting where the team checks progress towards its goal and removes blockers. It should take 15 minutes or less.

beginner: Keep it to 15 minutes at the same time each day.
Focus on the goal: are we on track, and what is in the way?
Walk the board from right to left, starting with work nearest to done.
Take detailed problem-solving to a separate conversation straight after.
Note blockers and who will clear them.
intermediate: Focus on the sprint goal or flow of work.
Walk the board rather than going person by person.
experienced: Let the team own the stand-up; the PM attends as a team member.
Watch for signs it has become a status report.
Use it to spot work that is stuck.

toolExamples.jira: Use the board view during the meeting.
toolExamples.trello: Walk the board from the 'done' side backwards.
toolExamples.linear: Use the cycle view to see what is in progress.

definitionOfDone: Focus on the goal, not individual status
pitfalls: Turning it into a status report for the PM
